FX-POSTER-001.says: Levels 6, as it starts: every channel of every pixel that shows lands on one of six steps, 0, 51, 102, 153, 204 or 255 (encoded, of 255); the grey ramp turns to six flat greys, the greys 42 and 43 either side of a step landing on 0 and 51, 127 and 128 on 102 and 153, 212 and 213 on 204 and 255; black and white stay; a pixel at half covering takes the same steps as its colour at full covering, at its own covering; the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-POSTER-002.says: Levels 2, the fewest: every channel is either 0 or full, so every pixel is one of eight colours; the grey 127 turns black and 128 white, the skin and its shadow white, the line black, the red #ff0000 and the blue #0000ff.

FX-POSTER-003.says: Levels 3: steps 0, 127.5 and 255; the greys 85 and 170 sit exactly on the steps and are taken up to 127.5 and 255, as the rule's 1e-4 decides, while 64 falls to 0, 128 lands on 127.5 and 212 on 255.

FX-POSTER-004.says: Levels 16: sixteen steps 17 apart; every channel lands on a step within one step of its own value, and the ramps show their bands close together.

FX-POSTER-005.says: Levels 256, the most: every 8-bit channel is already on a step, so the drawing is untouched, exactly.

FX-POSTER-006.says: Levels 255: 255 steps, one fewer than an 8-bit value has, so every channel between 0 and 255 is lifted a little, by at most one 8-bit step (v becomes 255 v / 254); black and white stay.

FX-POSTER-007.says: Levels 6.9: only the whole part counts, so it is FX-POSTER-001.

FX-POSTER-008.says: Levels keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-POSTER-002, frame 2, at 6, is FX-POSTER-001, and frame 4 has ten steps.

FX-POSTER-009.says: Levels keyed from 4 at frame 0 to 7 at frame 4, linear, every frame: 4.75 at frame 1 counts as 4, the same as frame 0; 5.5 at frame 2 counts as 5; 6.25 at frame 3 counts as 6, FX-POSTER-001; frame 4 has seven steps.

FX-POSTER-010.says: Levels eased from 256 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: frame 0 is the drawing; at frame 2 the levels have gone past 2 (to -80.55) and are held at 2, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-POSTER-002.

FX-POSTER-011.says: Levels 3 held (a hold key) at frame 0, then 16 at frame 4: frames 0 and 2 are FX-POSTER-003 and frame 4 is FX-POSTER-004.

FX-POSTER-012.says: FX-POSTER-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-POSTER-013.says: Levels 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POSTER-014.says: Levels 257, above 256. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POSTER-015.says: Levels 256.5, above 256: the range is on the number as written, before its whole part is taken. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POSTER-016.says: Levels -6, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POSTER-017.says: Levels keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POSTER-018.says: Levels keyed from 0 at frame 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
